summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for his eighth cycle of high-dose methotrexate since CNS lymphoma relapse, marking the first bimonthly maintenance dose. He tolerated the chemotherapy well, with no acute complications. Constipation was managed with magnesium citrate, and a stable chest rash was diagnosed as tinea corporis, treated with topical miconazole. Aspirin and omeprazole were held during hospitalization and restarted at discharge. Liver enzymes rose as expected post-chemotherapy but remained manageable. He was discharged home in stable condition with plans for outpatient follow-up and the next chemotherapy cycle in two months.
